name: Land of Giants
summary: An orc asks you to carry Chogg’s head to an ogre city in the northern hills. The offering may open a way to renew an old bond with the ogres.

sections.title: An Old Bond
sections.body: The orcs see a chance to renew their old alliance with ogres. Reports place the clan’s home in a stronghold among the northern hills, and Chogg’s head is meant to speak for you. Carry it to the ogre city and offer it as a token of friendship. The clan may hear your proposal, if they do not trample you first.

sections.title: At Clugfist’s Door
sections.body: At the ogre city, you present Chogg’s head to Clugfist. He recognizes that you have defeated Chogg’Zac and asks what you want with him. The offer of friendship has opened a chance to speak with the clan’s leader.

faq.q: Why am I bringing Chogg’s head to the ogres?
faq.answer: The orcs hope Chogg’s head will serve as a token of friendship and help renew their old alliance with the ogres.

faq.q: Where is the ogre clan’s home?
faq.answer: Reports place the clan’s stronghold in the hills far to the north.
Clugfist is the massive ogre you meet at the ogre city. He asks what you want with him.
Chogg’Zac is the ogre Clugfist says you have defeated.

faq.q: What do the orcs want from the ogres?
faq.answer: The orcs hope to call upon their old alliance with ogres and present a proposal to the clan.

angles.text: As an orc, you carry an offer rooted in the honored history of orcs fighting beside ogres.
